org_research: The Housing Action Coalition (HAC) is a member-supported nonprofit that advocates for producing more homes for people of all income levels to help alleviate California’s housing shortage, affordability and displacement crisis. We believe that everyone should have a safe, stable, affordable place to live in a community of their choice. California is experiencing a severe housing shortage that is driving historic economic, environmental, and social crises statewide. While several state-level housing policies have been enacted, they have not resulted in enough new homes near jobs, transit, and opportunity to meet this need. Some of the many dire consequences of this failure include: A disproportionate negative impact on renters and people on color. More than half of the state’s renters and nearly a third of its homeowners are burdened by housing costs. Overcrowding as a common response to high housing costs. Many endure substandard living conditions that threaten their health or safety, fearing that reporting code violations will lead to eviction into an overpriced, tight housing market.
